# One call of Pro.on(group) per line: the method, then its arguments. A name is in double quotes, a whole number
# is an integer, and a number with a decimal point is a double. The words true and false are booleans. An array is in
# brackets, without spaces, like [10,15,20,30]: it is an int[], or a double[] when any of its numbers has a decimal
# point; [] is an int[]. The Java engine's Pro runs each call on an empty group (tools/java-oracle) and
# tests/facade.test.ts runs the same call here: they must register the same names, with the same display hint and
# metadata. Add the line of every factory and overload you add.
